notes.title: Patch Note 2.5.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch 2.5.0[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/34fe152146a6e11a5bd32a41699eca74f892a9f0.png"][/img][/p][h2]Brazen Blaze Season 6 Act: 1 has begun![/h2][p]Starting this season, we will be adjusting the match rule schedule so that both [b]Round Team Match[/b] and [b]Survival Mode[/b] are always available.
[/p][p]We would also like to announce some adjustments to game balance.[/p][p]Valkyrie, in particular, was introduced as a Runner with excellent mobility and support abilities. However, her solo combat power was also high, resulting in a higher overall win rate than other Runners.[/p][p]Therefore, we will be making downward adjustments to balance her with other Runners without compromising the appeal of Valkyrie. At the same time, we will be improving runners with low win rates, aiming to improve overall balance.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope these adjustments will provide you with a fresher, more strategic competitive environment.
[/p][p]In addition, previously released bundles will be re-released and rotated weekly.[/p][p][b]We hope you continue to enjoy Brazen Blaze in Season 6![/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]■Featured Content[/b][/h2][p]- Changed the battle rules settings.[/p][p]  - Round Team Match and Survival mode will now be available at all times.[/p][p]  - Assist Items have been removed from Round Team Match (BO3)[/p][p]- Battle Pass "[b]Season 6 Act: 1[/b]" has begun.[/p][p]- "VELVET" and "MAGUS" bundles are now available in the shop.[/p][p]- Daily shop displays have been updated.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]■Balancing[/b][/h2][p][b]・VALKYRIE[/b][/p][p]▼ Decreased HP (800 → 750)[/p][p]▼ Reduced Boost Dash speed[/p][p]▼ Increased cooldown of Skill “Accelerator” (35s → 40s)[/p][p]▼ Decreased healing amount of Ultimate “Sanctuary” (300 → 200)[/p][p][/p][p][b]・VELVET[/b][/p][p]△ Increased charge speed of Main Weapon “Photon Blade”[/p][p] （Lv1: 0.7s → 0.5s / Lv2: 0.9s → 0.7s）
[/p][p][b]・Sub Weapon “Shake Grenade”[/b][/p][p]△ Increased knockback power when hitting an enemy at max upgrade[/p][p][/p][p][b]・Sub Weapon “Air Mine”[/b][/p][p]△ Increased damage when hitting an enemy (200 → 250)[/p][p][/p][h2][b]■Bug Fix[/b][/h2][p]-Fixed a bug where the assist item “Laser Cannon” could be used to attack a wide area with specific inputs.
-Fixed a bug where changes to the master volume setting were not saved when adjusted alone in the options menu.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: [UPDATE] Matchmaking System Overhaul PART 2 and the Road to Free to Play!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Runners![/p][p]This is the MyDearest team here to bring you the latest update![/p][p][b]Patch v1.23.0 is now live and AVAILABLE TO PLAY![/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][u][b]■Official Release Date[/b][/u][/p][p]Thursday, July 10th, 2025 (PDT)
*Maintenance end time will be announced later.[/p][h1]
[b]What’s New in Patch v1.23.0![/b][/h1][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeqH277VIk1yOGi4AYKPhLwKWJSSiVGjRR7uz0Ce6pjgBmunD4W1vwmMqhqQvRFq25MKFsXQYf94ZjLSiCwiZqytWY7rCxZrwtwAakq3KUX0hTDMMiY8bqoy5g6T9ztyXs6PNsxIg?key=fmjKUM-1z-75pJ8YDi2iag"][/img][/p][h2][b]⚙️Instant NPC Match & Player Refill Are Finally Here![/b][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcCsOwi4H9SVTZ_sDIKoMabflKf4Fp5yIE7HgNZ_0uFihdSq38tdgIsncIuYR_7aECXCVkor6up-r1NsEZuuzrXE8ckbmL9nMnDRzptgp2__xZFnY1FQZFd3ZkNN3BnGVMHBwoj4g?key=fmjKUM-1z-75pJ8YDi2iag"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for your patience, Runners! Two of the most highly requested matchmaking features have finally arrived![/p][list][*][p][b]Instant NPC Match Option[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Now, if you turn ON this setting from the matchmaking screen, a match will begin right away with your current team and automatically fill empty slots with NPCs. No more waiting![/p][list][*][p][b]Player Refill Function[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]If you're mid-match with NPCs and another player starts matchmaking, the match will seamlessly restart to include the new player in your game![/p][p]
[/p][p]Together, these changes allow for faster, more flexible matchmaking, no matter your team size or time of day![/p][h2][b]
🎉Brazen Blaze Turns 1 Year Old![/b][/h2][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfzO569AdYLsO0PrLixs21tyKnb9qf8OmmJ4qf_sSnJmX4J7siFbYfQidvaQJXezx1B63-mD2RMIijvlGo5nBvuCrnYBMIvdSvHIxsz3phQNY3YvTGQ0qPjyQWiH8h7Bdyga8DlDQ?key=fmjKUM-1z-75pJ8YDi2iag"][/img][/p][p]On [b]July 17th, Brazen Blaze officially celebrates its 1-year anniversary[/b]! [h1]Patch 1.20.0[/h1]

[h2]A Message From The Director:[/h2]
We would like to provide an update regarding the features originally planned for this release: [b]“Player Addition”[/b] and[b] “Instant NPC Match Start.”[/b]
To ensure stability, we will first roll out the feature that allows players to access Training and Challenge modes while waiting in matchmaking.

Based on how this feature is used, we will gradually implement the Player Addition and Instant NPC Match Start features in a future update. Following our investigation into the recent bug, we discovered that issues occur when the number of team members changes during the Runner Selection phase. As a result, we are prioritizing the release of the Training and Challenge access during the matchmaking feature, so we can observe when players tend to join or leave. This information will help us safely deploy the remaining features.

We sincerely apologize for the repeated delays and appreciate your continued patience and understanding.
[b]Thank you for bearing with us.[/b]

[h2]Featured Content[/h2]
[b]Players can now access areas outside the lobby (such as Training or Challenge) while waiting in matchmaking.[/b]
 - The number of players in matchmaking is shown in the top right corner of the screen.
 　
[i]Note: If you're in a team, each member can move to other areas individually.
Note: If the team is created in a private lobby, voice chat between team members is available in all areas.
Note: Although Closet access during matchmaking was originally planned, it has been disabled in this update due to a confirmed bug.[/i]

[b]Match End[/b]
- After a match ends, players can now choose to return to the lobby with their current team or leave the team. Previously, the rematch function would immediately begin the character pick phase. Now it has been changed to return players to the lobby so they can do other things while waiting.

[h2]Other[/h2]
- Shortened the detection time for player disconnection during matches.

[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]
- Issue in the New York City (Day) stage where players could respawn inside objects.
- Issue in the tutorial where falling out of bounds via a specific order could cause progress to become stuck.

[h2]Known Bugs[/h2]
- Players other than the Team Leader may be unable to select Challenge Mode during matchmaking. 　
[i]Note: This can be resolved by entering the Training Room, which will enable Challenge Mode selection. A fix for this issue is planned in next week’s update.[/i]
- In some cases, when returning to the lobby after a match, the Team Leader’s main console may not display correctly.

notes.title: Change of Maintenance Date and Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/a9a659443635f0d71f09cfa90c39fb3e71bc1368.png[/img]
Hey Runners, this is the Brazen Blaze Team with an announcement.

[b]Change of Maintenance Date and Upcoming Updates[/b]
The matchmaking update originally scheduled for today has been postponed to Tuesday, May 27th due to issues discovered in some of the newly added features.

Identifying the cause and implementing a proper fix is taking longer than expected.
We sincerely apologize for the delay and any inconvenience caused to players who were looking forward to this update.

The issue lies in the newly implemented [b]“Player Addition”[/b] feature as part of the matchmaking improvements. This feature is designed to automatically start a new match with six real players when they gather during a match that initially includes NPCs.

However, under certain conditions and timing  such as players joining or rematching, bugs may occur, including:
[list]
[*] Teams disbanding unexpectedly
[*] Matches failing to start properly
[/list]
Given that Brazen Blaze is a game centered on 3-player team cooperation, we have decided that it would be inappropriate to proceed with the update without resolving these critical issues.

We ask for a bit more time to ensure we deliver a stable and seamless matchmaking experience to all players.

We would also like to take this opportunity to share our plans for future updates.

[h2]Major updates currently planned include:[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new character (our 11th) to be added in mid-June
[*] A new stage to be released in July
[/list]

[h2]Additionally, Brazen Blaze will celebrate its 1st anniversary in July.[/h2]

[h1]To commemorate this milestone, we are planning to transition to a Free to Play model (base game will be free) around mid-July,
with the goal of bringing in more players and making battles even more exciting and accessible.[/h1]

For those who have already purchased Brazen Blaze, we are preparing a special thank-you gift as a token of our appreciation for your continued support.

Details regarding the Free to Play transition and this gift will be announced at a later date. Please stay tuned for further updates.

Thank you as always for your continued support of Brazen Blaze.

　- PLATINUM

　- PRESIDENT

[h2][b][url=https://mydearest.net/discord_sn_launch]Join the Official Discord[/url][/b][/h2]

[h2][b] ■About Brazen Blaze[/b][/h2]
Brazen Blaze is a melee combat focused 3v3 action game.
There's only one goal in this game: “Strike down your opponent.” Simple, right?
Want to punch someone? Go trigger-happy? Smash a statue of someone famous?
Do everything that you’ve ever dreamed!

[h2][b] ■Runners
[/b][/h2]
In "Brazen Blaze," you can choose from a roster of "Runners" each with unique Main Weapons and Skills to battle. Participate in combat using your preferred style, be it guns, shields, swords, or bombs, and employ tactics to aim for victory. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/04aa2b5746be121a7270eae24874c75ebebb7a41.png[/img]
In addition to the five Runners available during the open beta test—Riot, Legacy, Skybolt, Velvet, and Sunshine—two new Runners, Levin and Chillout, will be introduced in the Official Release version. These additional Runners will be available upon meeting specific conditions, which will be announced later.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/ff8c30be2638426f07eb33b9854251aa7f91d2eb.png[/img]

[h2][b]■Game Rules[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/dc5f23d09cb05c8fec9e195de89fc20e2df9a2db.png[/img]
[b]Round Team Match[/b]
3v3 team battle. You win a round by eliminating all the opposing team members. The first team to win two rounds wins the match.

[b]Stock Team Match[/b]
3v3 team battle. Each team shares a pool of stocks, and when a team member is defeated, they respawn after a set period. Victory is achieved by reducing the opposing team's stocks to zero and eliminating all opposing players.

[b]Custom Match[/b]
This feature allows you to create a room and to choose game rules and team divisions for the match with up to 6 players. In addition to the standard match rules, you can choose special rules such as the "Playground" for practice. Moreover, a "Spectator Mode" has been added, allowing you to watch the gameplay of other players.

[b]Target Challenge[/b]
Single-player game mode. Players aim to destroy all target drones placed on the stage within the time limit. Various stages and difficulty levels can be selected.

[h2][b]■Stages[/b][/h2]
In "Brazen Blaze," there are multiple stages where battles take place. 
Dash around these stages with different terrains using your Gauntlet.

[b]Paris (Day)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/b615d67563b4aa704643be770c6542820191566f.png[/img]

[b]New York City (Day)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/633de6eddbc9d8446e3d5d98167bff59d416a64f.png[/img]

[b]New York City (Night)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/5af6a9a0e1ab6c5afa16b665a92cf566387815b9.png[/img]

[h2][b]■Assist Items[/b][/h2]
Assist Items will appear during battles. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/4360102e6d04df05363179ac63a7a26dd2c17df3.png[/img]
These items can be randomly obtained by breaking the "Item Boxes" that appear on the stage. The more disadvantaged your situation, the stronger the items you are likely to receive. Use the various items to turn the tide of battle and become victorious!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/ac47795a0dfac132fb62e6611eaeb02ee168c4a9.png[/img]

[h2][b]■Runner Pass / Battle Pass
[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/ba08c226454a16b7e2f7c952e2492ec9a3089f91.png[/img]
[b]Runner Pass[/b]
By accumulating Mission Points and leveling up, you can unlock new Runners and new Sub Weapons, as well as other various rewards. In Season 1, two new Runner Passes, "Levin" and "Chillout," will be added. There is no time limit, so you can progress through any Runner Pass at your own pace.

[b]Battle Pass[/b]
Similar to the Runner Pass, you can earn rewards by accumulating Mission Points. However, the Battle Pass is a limited-time pass with a set duration, so be mindful of the end date while progressing.

Note: Items obtained through the Battle Pass can only be acquired during the active period, and there are currently no plans to make them available after the period ends.

[h2][b]■Shop
[/b][/h2]There will be 3 shops in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/c3bd8263126e607509809984fcbca623c3fc4676.png[/img]

[b]Daily Shop[/b]
The Daily Shop is a shop where new items appear every day. You can purchase various items using "Magna Credits" obtained from the Battle Pass or Runner Pass.

[b]Gold Shop[/b]
In the Gold Shop, you can purchase special items exclusive to the Gold Shop using Blazen Gold. Blazen Gold can be purchased in the game.

[b]Gem Shop[/b]
In the Gem Shop, you can purchase items using "Hazen Gems" distributed as rewards for specific events.

[h2][b]■Achievements[/b][/h2]
You can obtain badges and other items by meeting specific conditions.

[h2][b]■Closet[/b][/h2]
In the Closet, you can freely customize the skins, communication goods, and profiles you have obtained.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/eb0999fc2346f643c18614aed65ec46e595a336f.png[/img]


Thank you for supporting Brazen Blaze.



*Images and videos in this article are all under development and subject to change.

notes.title: Presidential Bulletin #9
notes.content:
[h2][u]Intro[/u][/h2]

Greetings, Runners!

It's been a month and a half since the Open Beta began. Hope you all are enjoying the Presidential War!

Next week, the Open Beta ACT: 3 will begin. With ACT: 2, new elements such as Custom Matches and Target Challenge were added, broadening the range of gameplay. However, ACT: 3 will introduce the biggest new feature to date.

Introducing… "Assist Items"! In this issue of the Presidential Bulletin, we will introduce the background behind adding these items and showcase several of the items to be implemented, complete with images.

When ACT: 3 begins, we hope you will play it and share your thoughts with us!

[h2][u]Why “Assist Items”?
[/u][/h2]

While many players are enjoying Brazen Blaze, we recognize a significant challenge in effectively conveying the game's appeal to those who haven't yet played or are just starting. One contributing factor is that in our pursuit of a competitive gameplay experience, it has become very difficult for players to win against opponents with superior skills, leading to one-sided matches.

To create more closely contested matches and enhance the excitement, we decided to implement "Assist Items" as an element that can potentially turn the tide of battle. This will give even teams that find themselves at a disadvantage a chance to win until the very end of the match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/d37a3c7fa7965c5356dccd6b522140d7531e1631.gif[/img]

With the addition of numerous items, Brazen Blaze will become even more lively and fun, resembling somewhat of a party game! We believe that the vibrant and entertaining visuals will lower the barrier for viewers to pick up the game and become new players.

Of course, for players who enjoy highly competitive matches, we plan to allow the option to disable items, enabling them to play Brazen Blaze as they have been. We hope everyone will enjoy both the new Brazen Blaze with Assist Items and the traditional Brazen Blaze.

[h2][u]“Assist Items” Showcase
[/u][/h2]

Now, let us introduce some of the Assist Items that will be implemented.
Please note that these items are still in development and may differ from the final version.

Assist Items can be randomly obtained by breaking “Item Boxes" that appear on the stage. The more unfavorable the situation, the higher the chance of obtaining powerful items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/46b6a7afc863d23a6e9ce6a5ec7aa6fb9c96f7ca.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Rocket Puncher
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/15a8e3609b3675395feec4ffa1289030c36bbf20.png[/img]
This rocket launcher fires a punching glove that chases down enemy players upon being shot. 
While it may look like a toy, its power is incredibly strong.

[h3][b]Slugger Bat
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/48c34feb52a04e6f9408abe1d40adae36b7c155e.png[/img]
"Let’s make an item to smack opponents!" With that in mind, we've made a bat. 
A full swing will send opponents flying.

[h3][b]Tornado Fan
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/3eab9b1df011a6a929f7afc277d7d734791cf77b.png[/img]
When you wave this fan, it generates a tornado that sends opponents flying high into the air. 
It can be used to drive away approaching enemies or to further stir up chaotic battles.

[h3][b]Dragon Energy
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/7b1c73a75c18ee5c17e0ae9f78a3b18f19cc86b7.png[/img]
Drinking this energy drink gives you invincibility for a certain period. 
Despite its obviously unhealthy design, consuming it allows you to stay up all night or even withstand being smacked by a Gauntlet!

In the update on June 20th, approximately 10 Assist Items will be implemented, including the ones mentioned above. We will continue to add more types of items in the future, so stay tuned!

[h2][u]Conclusion
[/u][/h2]

ACT: 3 introduces the new feature of "Assist Items”.. In addition to this, ACT: 3 will bring various other additions and improvements.

With the addition of Assist Items, we aim to make the game more enjoyable and accessible, similar to a party game, which should make it more appealing to new users. While the competitive aspect may decrease, rest assured that you will still be able to play Brazen Blaze as you know it by turning off items in the rules settings (to be implemented in a  future update).

This update is sure to make battles more chaotic and fun. We hope you'll try out the new combat with Assist Items after the update on June 20th.

We are also collecting feedback and suggestions for new Assist Items on Discord, so please feel free to share your thoughts and ideas with us!

notes.title: Presidential Bulletin #8
notes.content:
[u][h2]Intro[/h2][/u]
Greetings, Runners!

The Open Beta Test ACT: 2 of Brazen Blaze has begun!
In this Bulletin, we will introduce the new features added in Open Beta Test ACT: 2 and look back at ACT: 1 with various data.
ACT: 2 is packed with new features and rewards. After reading this Bulletin, please play the game and enjoy the new features!

[u][h2]ACT: 2 New Features[/h2][/u]
[h3][b]Custom Matches[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/e6deae9d613e6169676cf27771f423ad63e2560b.png[/img]
Custom Matches, which have been requested by many, are finally being added!
In Custom Matches, up to 6 players can freely choose rules, stages, and teams to play.
The selectable rules include familiar ones like "Round Team Match," "Stock Team Match," and "Survival," as well as new Custom Match-exclusive rules "Duel" and "Playground."

[b]Duel[/b]
This is a 1v1 rule introduced in Presidential Bulletin #3.
Unlike Team Matches or Survival where you need to keep track of multiple players' movements, you can focus on one opponent, allowing you to gain experience in combat movements.
Even if you don't play well, you won't be bothering anyone, so feel free to be more aggressive than usual.
If you have one friend playing Brazen Blaze, you can easily start a match. Polish your moves in 1v1 battles and use them to shine in other rules.

[b]Playground[/b]
This is not a match but a rule where you can freely explore the stage.
During actual matches, it might be hard to remember the terrain or the locations of recovery items due to focusing on opponents and stage collapses. This rule allows you to thoroughly explore and confirm those aspects. Understanding the terrain is the first step to victory. Use this for practice and research!
You can also enjoy a leisurely stroll through the stage with friends. Use it for a break between matches.

[b][h3]Target Challenge[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/68d2cd61a98129def70b0c9bc346965d40accf3a.png[/img]
To respond to requests for "a mode to play and practice solo," we have added a new mode called "Target Challenge."
In this mode, you compete for the time taken to destroy all target drones placed on the stage. In this initial release, there are two stages with different target locations and numbers.
You can freely choose your Runner and Sub Weapons, so find the most efficient combination to destroy the targets.
Please share your best times on Discord!


[u][h2]ACT: 1 Review[/h2][/u]
[b][h3]Overall Feedback[/h3][/b]
We have received a lot of feedback from many players, and we sincerely thank everyone.
We will continue to develop Brazen Blaze referencing your voices to make it a better game, so please keep playing and providing feedback!

Many players have pointed out the following issues, and our development team prioritizes solving these problems:
- Matching with players of significantly different skill levels, leading to quick defeats
- Long matchmaking times

These two issues make it difficult for new players to continue playing Brazen Blaze. To address this, we have added "Custom Matches" and "Target Challenge" as places to practice controls outside of Team Matches and Survival. You can also play "Target Challenge" during times when matchmaking is difficult.
Additionally, we plan to update the matchmaking function in early June to reduce waiting times before matches start.
There are other issues and areas for improvement, which we will address in future updates.

Now let's look at some data from ACT: 1.

[h3][b]Runner Win Rates[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/0e7722943f27b076dd9c24cfc14f2b4dfd32a6bd.png[/img]
As you can see, Legacy had the highest win rate among all Runners.
This is likely due to his high health, Magna Shield to block long-range attacks, and the long distance of his Boost Dash, enabling stable gameplay.
Velvet was the only Runner with significant differences in win rates across different rules.

[h3][b]Runner Pick Rates[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/0d11c5a2dd424351c43914354b8823f23a1412f3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/2d69604ab9de21360baf7dadf43f4873b71d2c18.png[/img]
*Stock Team Match data is up to May 8th.
There was no significant difference in pick rates by rule, and Skybolt was the most used overall.
The usefulness of the Predator's Eye for enemy detection in Team Matches and the ability to deal damage with the Hybrid Rifles even if punches are difficult to land are likely major factors.


[u][h2]Conclusion[/h2][/u]
This time, we introduced the new features of ACT: 2 and looked back at ACT: 1.

Whether you played ACT: 1 extensively or not, we hope you will enjoy the new features in ACT: 2. Though not mentioned here, be sure to check out the exclusive skins and items available in the updated Battle Pass.

We are still looking for feedback from everyone in ACT: 2. Please share your opinions on Discord!
For those who haven't joined our Discord yet, here is the link: https://discord.com/invite/ESX8fJSdxy

notes.title: Presidential Bulletin #6
notes.content:
[h2][u]Intro[/u][/h2]
Greetings, Runners!

The long-awaited moment has arrived! The second Open Beta Test has finally commenced.
We're all about making Brazen Blaze a better game, and we love hearing what you think! Head over to our Discord server and share your thoughts with us. Everyone's opinions are welcome!
[url=https://discord.com/invite/ESX8fJSdxy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/cc32b6093d34240f6f8f738e9d7777371aaeffdf.png[/img]
[/url]
If you've already started playing, we want to give you a quick rundown of some updates that have been made since the last test. In this Bulletin, we'll go over adjustments to the battle balance, new rules, and some updated effects. We've also made a ton of other updates, and we've fine-tuned everything down to the smallest details to make sure players have an even better gameplay experience.
After reading this Bulletin, please test the evolution of the game's strategy and excitement by participating in the Open Beta Test!

[h2][u]New Rule[/u][/h2]
We've made some changes to the game rules since the first Open Beta Test so that more Runners can have a good time playing.

The previous rules were as follows.

[h3][b]Round Team Match[/b][/h3]
In the first Open Beta, we introduced a 3vs3 round team match with a tense game system that doesn't allow respawns. The objective of the game was to defeat all enemies to win the round. It was a simple and easy-to-understand rule, with a clear victory condition. We believe that many Runners enjoyed this game mode.

However, there were challenges such as:

- In a team of three, each member's performance has a significant impact on the group's success. The loss of one member would greatly affect the team's dynamic.
- If a player died shortly after the round started, their playtime was short.
- Passive play became more common, resulting in shorter engagement times.

So, for new players who just started playing the game, it was pretty easy to get confused with less playtime. Plus, they had to deal with facing real online players in battles, which made it even more challenging for them.

As a result, we decided to introduce new rules for this Open Beta.

[h3][b]Stock Team Match[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/6f2c004c7edb55a7b979b5336bf6b968b5411138.gif[/img]
It's a 3vs3 team battle rule, where you cooperate with your team members to fight.

- Each team shares a life pool.
- When a team member is defeated, one stock is consumed, and they respawn after a certain time.
- The victory condition is to reduce the opposing team's stock to zero and defeat all opposing players.

This rule has the following characteristics:

[b]- Since respawning is possible, all players can ensure playtime.
- Due to the stock system, the impact of a single death is relatively minor.[/b]

It allows for an aggressive and proactive fighting style that wasn't possible in Round Team Matches, making it a rule that can be enjoyed more casually.

[h3][b]Survival[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/8cbbbd5ad601842a7ce65c23d1b9977df04165ad.gif[/img]
A battle with 4 players. 

-Players possess 3 lives each, and being defeated 3 times results in elimination.
-The victory condition is to be the last one surviving.

This rule has the following characteristics:

[b]-It's an individual battle, not a team battle.
-Since respawning is possible, all players can ensure playtime.
-With fewer participating players, the battle situation is easier to grasp.
-You can always choose your favorite Runner, making it easier to practice.
-Even if you lose, you can quickly move on to the next match, making it easy to play at a good tempo.
[/b]
This rule allows for enjoyment as an individual battle. Moreover, not only does it require offensive actions, but also evading, making it easier for beginners who are not yet adept at attacking to become accustomed to movement by focusing on evasion, ultimately leading to an improvement in play skills.

With the introduction of new rules, we believe that beginners can start with Survival, and as they become more familiar with the game, they can enjoy strategic team battles in Stock Team Match. Please play a lot!

[h2][u]Battle Balance Adjustments
[/u][/h2]Since the open beta test in February, we've adjusted the parameters to ensure that everyone can enjoy playing with all the Runners more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/05ada225b2159002cd90bfa708449d50975a55ad.gif[/img]
As you can see in this video, we've adjusted the slash speed parameters to make playing with VELVET even more enjoyable.
The other Runner parameters we adjusted are as follows:

[h3][b]-RIOT
[/b][/h3]RIOT is a character designed for ease of use. In this adjustment, we've focused on making them even easier to use by enhancing the firepower of the Battle SMG.

[h3][b]-LEGACY[/b][/h3]
In the previous Open Beta, LEGACY achieved the highest win rate. We adjusted the amount of gauge required to activate the Ultimate and its effect duration while maintaining balance among other Runners.

[h3][b]-SKYBOLT[/b][/h3]
In the last Open Beta, SKYBOLT was the most popular Runner. She had crazy high DPS (damage per second), so we nerfed the Hybrid Rifle's attack power. But, we also made some changes to make it easier to use the Ultimate.

[h3][b]-VELVET
[/b][/h3]VELVET wasn't very popular and didn't win many battles, but we think she has a lot of potential. We made some changes to help her do better - we boosted her health and made her photon blade stronger overall.

[h3][b]-SUNSHINE[/b][/h3]
Throwing bombs is already fun with this Runner, but to maximize the enjoyment of the bombs, we've increased their radius. This is especially effective on stages with many high grounds, like "New York City Day," where we expect more active performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/9f8ac5c5384db53f7f25f00fee135dea8b52d14f.gif[/img]

You can check out how the new balance adjustments work by fighting with all the Runners and see how the parameter changed. These changes have made it possible to create more diverse strategies. Even Runners that didn't stick for you in the previous test might be a lot more fun now. So, go ahead and give them all a try!

[h2][u]Effect Updates[/u][/h2]
Since our first Open Beta, we have made several updates to the presentation aspects of Brazen Blaze. One of the most fun things about the game is the ability to destroy everything on the stage. To enhance the game's immersion even further, we have updated the destruction of cars on the stage to provide a more engaging experience. It even deals damage and blows away Runners now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/d99c365651f292b5770e561d5753a23691235584.gif[/img]

Also, this item, which is used for healing in the game, can now be destroyed by hitting it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/6231e5f909d7360e50a6b5593812621aee119512.gif[/img]

Additionally, we've made various updates to the stages in the game to enhance their realism and presence for your enjoyment. With these changes, Runners will be able to immerse themselves even more in the game's world.

Here, we've introduced updates related to the stage presentations, but there have also been many updates to sound, UI, and more. Be sure to play and see for yourself!

[h2][u]Conclusion[/u][/h2]
We've made some changes to Brazen Blaze, including adjusting the battle balance, adding new rules and updating the presentation. We reckon these changes will make the game even more fun for you.

We're still working on improving the game, and we appreciate your feedback. Please let us know what you think on Discord. We're excited to hear from you and make Brazen Blaze the best it can be.

We're also running some cool campaigns on Discord that we think you'll love. By joining in, you can get the latest info, connect with other players, and even earn some neat prizes. So, take a look and join in the fun!


For those who haven't joined our Discord yet, here is the link: https://discord.com/invite/ESX8fJSdxy
[url=https://discord.com/invite/ESX8fJSdxy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/cc32b6093d34240f6f8f738e9d7777371aaeffdf.png[/img]
[/url]

‘Til the next issue of the Presidential Bulletin, Runners!


[u][h2]Defy the Rules, Unchain Yourself![/h2][/u]

notes.title: How to join Brazen Blaze Open Beta Test
notes.content:
Greetings, Runners!
 
Tomorrow on April 25th (PDT), the Open Beta Test for Brazen Blaze will start worldwide.
To join our Open Beta Test, follow the steps below to download and prepare your device.
 
[h2][u]Preparations[/u][/h2]
[h3][b]■Download the application[/b][/h3]
Once the Open Beta Test starts on April 26th, 2024 (PDT), players will be able to download the Open Beta Test version of the game from Meta Quest Store and Steam Store.

After successfully downloading the application from either store, start the game and head to the next step.

[h3][b]■Choosing Account Service[/b][/h3]When playing the game for the first time, a screen as below will show up for you to link your account. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/5ac452ab140dfb982690b60248079971535788fc.png[/img]

[b]1) Play with Discord Account[/b]
Login to your Discord account from the browser to link your Discord account.

[b]2) Play with MyDearest Account[/b]
Key-in your email address used to register your MyDearest HUB account.
A verification code would be sent to your email and key in the code to link your MyDearest account.
[url=https://mydearesthub.com/signup?title_id=400][b]Click here to create an account[/b][/url]

[h3][b]■Tutorial[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/433e7df4b3fb2fe2cc975c4d12f0d503e1f26c33.gif[/img]
After you link your account, a tutorial will start.
Follow the instructions to learn the basic controls.
 
[h3][b]■Online Match[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/a262e55fd8bd18be1e434c21a9d2ab6807fb8b09.png[/img]

After finishing the tutorial, you will move to the lobby and be able to choose which mode to play.

[h3][b]■Game Rules[/b][/h3]
[b]1) Stock Team Match[/b]
A 3vs3 team deathmatch where you cooperate with your fellow Runners to defeat the opposing team. Each team shares 8 lives; One stock is consumed each time a team member is defeated, after which they respawn after a certain period. Victory means reducing the opposing team's stock to zero and defeating all opposing players!

In Stock Team Match, players could enjoy the game in a team with 2 other players.
Players can play with their friends with any of the following options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/02f143015f0a574eba1281894e3619fbcc475400.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/61c5da3f37c1bcad930f7befb1ddf5f3e64e6d2d.png[/img]

-Share the "Team Code" displayed with your friends.
-Press the "Join other team" button and enter the Team Code you received from your friend.
-Follow each other in the game to become "Friends" and select "Invite Friends."

[b]2) Survival[/b]
A free-for-all deathmatch through a 1vs1vs1vs1
format. Four Runners fight against each other, with the goal of protecting
oneself from running out of lives and accumulating kills simultaneously.
Victory means being the last Runner standing!

[h3][b]■Runner Selection[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/9daefba0cc334b82c1f67bfeb2547f392893cb58.gif[/img]
After a team is formed, players will pick their Runner and Sub Weapon in turn.
Note that in Stock Team Match mode, players choose their Runner in order, and you cannot choose the same Runner with other team members.
When everyone has chosen their Runners and an opposing team is found, the match will start.

[h3][b]■Stun, Kill, and Finisher[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/84924407bca408d2310a101e30ca0b6512d3b521.gif[/img]
By attacking your opponent and reducing their HP to 0, the opponent will enter a "Stun" state. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/aea8cd9d745bdd2d2e87f2262f687c23a1a088c8.gif[/img]
You can "Kill" an opponent in this stunned state by landing a punch on them.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/bee031bfc30c9d8ffebc37a58ef4931a666bff9b.gif[/img]
When killing the last player of the opposing team, a Runner-specific “Finisher” will activate. Make sure to check out all the Finisher moves with all Runners.

If the killed player has stock left, the player will respawn after a certain duration.

But if their stock is 0, they will not respawn and have the option to continue watching the current game or return to lobby.

Additionally, as time passes from the start of the match, the stage will gradually collapse. Be careful not to fall off the stage, as it will be treated as an instant death.
 
[h3][b]■Open Beta Test Precautions[/b][/h3]
-       The game might not function properly due to unexpected errors or network traffic.
-   	This version is under development, and its content may differ from the Official Release.
-       If players encounter any bugs, players could send us an inquiry through the Quick Menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/ebb12badfc130c73f7d596becc32b65d5015e087.png[/img]
*Please be aware that players must have a linked account to send an inquiry.

Thank you for supporting Brazen Blaze.

notes.title: Presidential Bulletin #4
notes.content:
[u][h2]Intro[/h2][/u]
Greetings, Runners!

The Open Beta is coming up, and the team is in their final push! Soon, we’ll tell you about the specific schedules - hang on there, Runner!

In this issue of the Presidential Bulletin, we’re telling a story about how Brazen Blaze came to be. Like all great ideas, it started with a few notes on a piece of paper - and so we want you to know how Brazen Blaze evolved to its current, FXXKING awesome state!

If you’re curious about the Brazen beginnings, or if you’re simply interested in how we built the game from the ground up, you’re in the right place.


[u][h2]Origin of Brazen Blaze[/h2][/u]

Brazen Blaze began with a user-participation project called [url=https://mydearestvr.com/en/products/pjg.html]PROJECT: GATHERING[/url]. 
In developing a new VR multiplayer game, we held planning meetings throughout MyDearest. From over 50 proposals, we narrowed it down to the final three. Among these, we let our users choose the game we would develop as the final decision-maker. Below are the three-game proposals that made the final cut.

[b][h3]CODE: BELL[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/a1bcc0fa84a3301e0cc48f1b3a266b98981f23b8.png[/img]
A VR 4vs1 survival game. A life-or-death scream-filled survival with friends.

[b][h3]CODE: CAMP[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/0b151bd7c677477824b2abb116e17a11a908cd2c.png[/img]
A VR cooperative camping fantasy. A marshmallow party with friends, warmed by a dragon's breath.

[b][h3]CODE: GAUNTLET[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/44a0601bdf43eb59f9d2b5bfccd627c13e8a12db.png[/img]
A VR 3vs3 team strategy battle. A flashy team battle with friends using superpowers.

As many of you may have guessed from the name and content, the project that received the most user support and was chosen for development was CODE: GAUNTLET. 
Through various twists and turns, it has become what is now known as Brazen Blaze.


[u][h2]Prototype Ver.1 Development[/h2][/u]
Once it was decided to develop CODE: GAUNTLET, a prototype was quickly created.
A prototype is a trial version designed to test the core systems of a game with the minimum necessary elements. In game development, prototypes are often used to test whether a game will be enjoyable. Because the purpose of a prototype is to test the "fun" aspect, its appearance tends to be quite simple. Initially, the characters were modeled as follows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/4a752123c01a023c8b199e58b87ab2075cadd8de.png[/img]

The initial concept of CODE: GAUNTLET was "a team battle where players use telekinesis to freely levitate and throw objects at each other." However, as the gameplay was tested with the prototype, several issues quickly became apparent:
[list]
[*] It was difficult to defeat opponents by throwing objects at them.
[*] The act of throwing objects at targets that were far away made it hard to feel a sense of having taken them down.
[*] The necessity to hold an object to attack slowed down the tempo of the battles.
[/list]
Therefore, the decision was made to drastically change the direction while retaining only the concept of "a 3vs3 action game using gauntlets."


[u][h2]Prototype Ver.2 Development[/h2][/u]
Based on the lessons learned from the old prototype, we proceeded with development following these guidelines:
[list]
[*] Fast and free movement
[*] Pursuing the fun of close-quarters melee combat
[*] Intuitive controls, taking advantage of VR
[/list]

[b][h3]Fast and Free Movement[/h3][/b]
Using prototype ver.1 as a counterexample, high-speed movement using the gauntlet was implemented under the hypothesis that "good tempo in battles leads to fun."
Below is the initial boost dash implemented in prototype ver.2, from which you can see the prototype of the current boost dash.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/c7be43c91d7473c30ade94409d4ea401b7c98de5.gif[/img]


[b][h3]Pursuing the fun of close-quarters melee combat[/h3][/b]
Instead of throwing objects, we significantly shifted the combat mechanism towards direct attacks with the gauntlet. The idea was that, since it's VR, we wanted to move away from watching an opponent fall from a distance to defeating them up close! This design philosophy is why stuns can be achieved with long-range attacks, but kills can only be made through close combat. Below is what killing looked like in prototype ver.2.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/5e1baf60c0ebaa62fdef7c504f19ba47e952e48d.gif[/img]


[b][h3]Intuitive controls, taking advantage of VR[/h3][/b]
As a result of trying various control methods in the old prototype, we concluded that VR games must have intuitive controls. You can't see your own hands when wearing VR gear, making complex controller operations unfeasible. Therefore, we decided to use only the grip and trigger for basic operations.
Punching, boost dashing, using the Main Weapon, using the Sub Weapon, activating skills, launching the Ultimate, climbing walls—all these actions are performed using just the grip and trigger, based on the design philosophy of creating actions that are intuitive and straightforward.
Below is the initial implementation of the Ultimate in the prototype ver.2. From this point, you can see that activating it involves pressing both fists together. (This would later become Skybolt’s Ultimate.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/6bcefce21e03339e0597d60f352271a9b274b053.gif[/img]

With the core game system established, we were able to develop prototype ver.2 to a level where we all agreed it was "fun to play!"


[u][h2]From “CODE: GAUNTLET” to “Brazen Blaze”[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/10dc5919cb3fe5c25625b132c372f5abb2bd6fdf.png[/img]

Although the prototype ver.2 was fun to play, the entire team felt that the game still lacked a certain flavor as a game; it was missing a defining theme. 
After much discussion, the theme that emerged was "Defy the Rules, Unchain Yourself"
While playing the new prototype, the dev team particularly enjoyed actions prohibited in real life, such as "destroying the stage" and "taunting stunned opponents." The idea was to embrace these as the core of the game's enjoyment - and, by extension - what makes it unique.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/836267501e45ba989eede38d7e0926141575fa91.gif[/img]

The concept of "Finishers" was also derived from this idea. Actions such as punching an opponent to oblivion, shooting guns recklessly, or slicing in two with a single stroke have a certain allure that everyone has wanted to try at least once. These actions were incorporated as "Finishers".
Below is the first implementation of the Finisher in Prototype Ver. 2. (This would later become Riot's Finisher.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/261f10199f3ef97a72a1dedbd5c8d45a29e8b449.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/c29a1daa8760a4a77efb93d3fccd8c838d71320a.gif[/img]

Based on the theme "Defy the Rules, Unchain Yourself", the characters, setting of the world, and even the title were decided in turn. Combining all these elements together resulted in the creation of "Brazen Blaze" as everyone knows it today.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/f6b4f95eae2dab306ec095a0c6ec6a2ef6a68acc.png[/img]

[u][h2]Conclusion[/h2][/u]

Today, we talked about the origins of Brazen Blaze. It started with the user-participation project PROJECT: GATHERING, and evolved from CODE: GAUNTLET's concept of "a team battle where players use telekinesis to levitate and throw objects at each other" to the current theme of "Defy the Rules, Unchain Yourself".

If the origins of Brazen Blaze have piqued your interest, we’d love for you to join our upcoming Open Beta test. We would also be delighted to hear your thoughts on the newsletter and the game on Discord!

For those who haven't joined our Discord yet, here is the link: https://discord.com/invite/ESX8fJSdxy

‘Til the next issue of the Presidential Bulletin, Runners!

notes.title: Presidential Bulletin #1
notes.content:
[u][h2]Intro[/h2][/u]

Greetings, Runners!

The year of the dragon began with hopes for Brazen Blaze to reach unprecedented heights. Going into the 2nd month, we’ve already achieved a few things we are excited to share with everyone.

And so we begin with our Presidential Bulletins! These will contain all of our updates, including recent events and results, the most recent updates to the game, and all other info we feel is essential for every Runner to know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/b3fd3424bd4ea5106f72ce9546c7cb7cac0d2e16.gif[/img]

To promptly start our first Presidential Bulletin issue, let’s take a quick look at the results of the Open Beta and have a rundown of the basics we believe would help every aspiring Runner PWN the next time. The Lobby doors open!


[u][h2]The Open Beta[/h2][/u]

The recent 8-day Open Beta run has proven how passionate our team and the community are. We received tremendous feedback from the community on how we can improve the game. To celebrate, let’s look at our Open Beta numbers so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/ba9719f48a76b35223c4baf855944f6e57cd5b05.png[/img]

Quick Note: Due to Velvet’s mediocre win rate, we're fixing Runner balance issues that should ultimately make her have a better win rate in the future.


[u][h2]Brazen Blaze 101[/h2][/u]
So, a new challenger arrives at the lobby. You look like you need a hand. Here’s what you need to know before you shoot ‘em rounds and punch ‘em foes sky high.

[h3][b]The Training Room[/b][/h3]
You can’t just jump  into the battlefield; you’ll have to know how to use it! While many skip directly to matches, the tutorial ensures you’re adequately equipped with basic knowledge before beating up other Runners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/a397188fabcdce8d2501e5a5dc4319323991a8e9.gif[/img]

You can practice basic movements in the training room and check each Runner’s arsenal, including skills, sub-weapons, and ultimates. Before you hit the road, the training room can help you decide which Runner you’ll be mainly, depending on your playstyle.
Practice your moves and understand each Runner’s capabilities. In no time, you’ll gain complete confidence to go mano-a-mano!

[h3][b]Voice Chat[/b][/h3]
Communication is a huge factor in winning matches in team competitions, whether in video games or not. While only some people love the idea of talking on voice chat, remember that everyone wants to win games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/5493ff31bcf5de120d418d6614041b3cbd9aaa91.gif[/img]

If you’re shy, it’s okay - no one’s forcing you. Although, try turning on voice chat! Keep in mind: a coordinated team is a winning team!

[h3][b]Dashing in the Air[/b][/h3]
Do you know you can dash in the air? You can use both hands to boost while airborne if you're not holding an item (or two, like when Skybolt is using both her guns).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/f010a9c271bc5c1e17faa5ed1661d1c0047d1ec1.gif[/img]

Remember that you dash in the direction your hand is heading, not your head. Use that to your advantage.

[h3][b]This is not an FPS![/b][/h3]
Punching is your primary damage dealer! The other stuff - your guns, grenades, and skills - are just for extra damage and/or to make it easier for you to punch them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/66fa2cb004b3ead90f61294043c06fc996b630c9.gif[/img]

Use your guns, grenades, and skills to set yourself or your teammates up for the perfect punching sequence! Remember, you have fists as giant as your head for a reason!

[h3][b]Lock-on![/b][/h3]
The fast-paced nature of Brazen Blaze will require you to focus on your enemies. Since it’s a VR game, manually focusing on enemies may cause stiff necks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/913a5bd014aa853c20e584fbfd2523c5622aaac9.gif[/img]

Thankfully, there’s a Lock-on system in place! If you find it challenging to lock-on using your sticks, you can change your settings in-game.

[h3][b]Jump like a Gorilla![/b][/h3]
Pro-tip: Did you know you can gain extra airtime by using your hands? Smack your palms on the floor and get extra mobility!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/f91c470a7f9c37e53639f8bb81f580e5fa2ec9db.gif[/img]

By the way, "Gorilla Jump" was a placeholder name for it as it looks like the way gorillas move, but we ended up loving it, making it canon.

[h3][b]Recovering a friend[/b][/h3]
When an ally staggers and gets stunned, ensure you’re around to heal them back to battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/6666ce823dd2ee994764e5f5e068917bcb8265ab.gif[/img]

You can recover your allies by touching them. Remember, numbers win games!

[h3][b]Healing Items[/b][/h3]
In every stage, you'll find fixed items glowing in green. Punch them to recover some health!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/a7681c01223fccc8636042d21c4a8005fa237a95.gif[/img]

Initially, you had to grab and use these health items. Still, punching them felt better, considering how important it is to the game.

[h3][b]Move away and Recover![/b][/h3]
Battles in Brazen Blaze require you to be smart about your movement. Remember, you don't always have to fight - you have limited health!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/c054f7de5d5cc84ab531bacc6dce9ec52210e2b9.gif[/img]

Make sure you move away for a while when you’re low. You will slowly recover while doing so, making you ready for another round of fistfights soon enough!

[h3][b]Practice makes Perfect![/b][/h3]
Losing matches with one Runner doesn’t mean you suck with other Runners! We have different characters for a reason. Mix and match your playstyle until you find your main!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/903464bc363ef8951cfdda63d745d2fbdf233058.gif[/img]


[u][h2]What’s next?[/h2][/u]
We recently announced our 2nd Open Beta coming this Spring, 2024, and we can’t wait to bump fists with everyone again! 

As we move forward in our journey, your support remains paramount. Your continued feedback will help shape Brazen Blaze into what it’s bound to become in the VR gaming space. Keep in touch with us, and we’ll continue to deliver as always!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/740cc4ec37e4c14a05c383560461141786a41fcd.png[/img]
Hello Runners, this is the Brazen Blaze management team.

We have launched our Brazen Blaze Registration Program on December 19, 2023 (Wed). 

During this program, according to the number of participating players, all players will receive a number of Hazen Gems when Brazen Blaze is officially released, which could be used to exchange various in-game items such as character skins.

[b]Program duration[/b]
December 19, 2023 (Wed) - February 12, 2024 (Tue) 23:59

[b]How to participate[/b]
By the end of the program, we will accumulate the number of participants from all methods listed below.
[list]
[*] Total of Brazen Blaze OBT registrations (number of MyDearestHUB accounts)
[*] Total of Brazen Blaze Steam Wishlist
[*] Total of Brazen Blaze official X (formerly Twitter) followers (@BrazenBlazeVRJP, @BrazenBlazeVR)
[*] Total of Brazen Blaze official Discord participants (VR Haven / VR Agit)
[/list]

[b]Receiving rewards[/b]
Rewards will be distributed to all players after Brazen Blaze is officially released. However, only players who started to play during the first month after release will be eligible.

[b]Achievement rewards according to the number of registrations[/b]


[u]No. of participants / Rewards[/u]
30,000 participants: 100 Hazen Gems to all players
40,000 participants: 100 Hazen Gems to all players
50,000 participants: 200 Hazen Gems to all players
70,000 participants: 200 Hazen Gems to all players
100,000 participants: 400 Hazen Gems to all players

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597976/bd6524c9ba2d29b1cebd96734105f55cc30a555f.png[/img]
Hazen Gem is a currency to be used in Brazen Blaze to exchange various in-game items such as Runner skins and Gauntlet skins.
*Runner skins and Gauntlet skins can be exchanged for 1,000 Hazen Gems.

[b]Terms and Conditions[/b]
Players do not need to apply to participate in this program.
This program is subject to change or cancellation without prior notice.

Thank you for supporting Brazen Blaze.
